    public List<String> getBookmarkText(int pageIndex) {
        ArrayList<String> hoverText = new ArrayList<String>();
        Page prevPage = null;
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
            String s;
            if (pageIndex * 2 + i >= this.book.pages.size()) continue;
            Page page = this.book.pages.get(pageIndex * 2 + i);
            if (!(prevPage != null && page.pageId.equals(prevPage.pageId) || StringUtils.func_151246_b((String)(s = page.getSummaryTitle())))) {
                hoverText.add(EnumChatFormatting.GRAY + I18n.func_135052_a((String)"gui.metahuman_log.bookmark.page.long", (Object[])new Object[]{EnumChatFormatting.WHITE + s + EnumChatFormatting.GRAY, page.pageNumber}));
            }
            prevPage = page;
        }
        return hoverText;
    }

    public boolean intersects(Rectangle rect, List<Rectangle> list) {
        for (Rectangle rect1 : list) {
            if (!rect.intersects(rect1)) continue;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    public Point offset(Widget widget, WidgetType type, int left, int top, int pageWidth) {
        Point pos = widget.alignment.offset(widget, left, top, pageWidth);
        Point pos1 = widget.type.offset(widget, type);
        pos.translate(pos1.x, pos1.y);
        return pos;
    }

    public Point getOffset(JsonClickable jsonClickable, int left, int top, int pageWidth) {
        String alignment = jsonClickable.getAlignment();
        Rectangle bounds = new Rectangle(-1, -1);
        for (Rectangle rect : jsonClickable.getBounds()) {
            bounds.add(rect);
        }
        if (alignment.equals("right")) {
            bounds.x *= -1;
            bounds.x += left + pageWidth - bounds.width;
        } else {
            bounds.x = alignment.equals("center") ? (bounds.x += left + (pageWidth - bounds.width) / 2) : (bounds.x += left);
        }
        return new Point(bounds.x, bounds.y + top);
    }

    public String formatText(String text) {
        text = text.replace("\\n", "\n");
        if ((text = text.replaceAll("&([a-f0-9rklmnor])", "\u00a7$1")).contains("<") && text.contains(">")) {
            for (KeyBinding keyBind : this.field_146297_k.field_71474_y.field_74324_K) {
                String s = String.format("<%s>", keyBind.func_151464_g());
                if (!text.contains(s)) continue;
                text = text.replace(s, GameSettings.func_74298_c((int)keyBind.func_151463_i()));
            }
        }
        return text;
    }

    public void drawParsedText(String text, int left, int top, int pageWidth, List<Rectangle> widgetBounds, List<Clickable> clickables, List<EnumChatFormatting> lineColors) {
        String newText = text;
        String linkStart = "<link=";
        String linkEnd = "</link>";
        HashMap<Integer[], String> links = new HashMap<Integer[], String>();
        HashMap<Integer[], EnumChatFormatting> colors = new HashMap<Integer[], EnumChatFormatting>();
        while (newText.contains(linkStart) && newText.contains(linkEnd)) {
            int i;
            int index;
            int startIndex = index = newText.indexOf(linkStart);
            int endIndex = index;
            int totalIndex = index;
            int indexColorStart = -1;
            EnumChatFormatting color = null;
            String transferId = "";
            for (i = index + linkStart.length(); i < newText.length(); ++i) {
                String s = newText.substring(i);
                if (s.startsWith(">")) {
                    transferId = newText.substring(index + linkStart.length(), i);
                    startIndex = i + 1;
                    if (indexColorStart < 0) break;
                    String colorName = newText.substring(indexColorStart + 3, i);
                    for (EnumChatFormatting format : EnumChatFormatting.values()) {
                        if (!format.name().equals(colorName)) continue;
                        color = format;
                        break;
                    }
                    transferId = transferId.substring(0, transferId.length() - (colorName.length() + 3));
